name: portscope-dev
description: Shows the dev servers of this VS Code window in the status bar and opens them in one click.

scripts.lint: oxlint && bun run typecheck && bun run knip && bun run format:check
scripts.package:check: bun run format && bun run lint && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.package:vsix: bun run package:check && vsce package --out portscope-dev.vsix

portScope.refreshIntervalSeconds.description: How often PortScope scans for dev servers while the window is focused.

portScope.healthCheck.markdownDescription: Send a `HEAD` request to each dev server to tell a server that answers (green) from one that is only bound (yellow), or answers with a 5xx status (red). Turn this off if you do not want any extra request in your dev server logs.

portScope.healthRecheckSeconds.markdownDescription: A server that answered is asked again after this many seconds, so a server that froze turns yellow. `0` never asks again.

portScope.healthPath.markdownDescription: Request path of the health check, for example `/health`. Use it when `/` is slow or not served.

portScope.ignorePorts.markdownDescription: Ports PortScope never shows or checks, for example a debug port or a database.

portScope.openPath.markdownDescription: Path added to the URL when you open or copy a server, for example `/admin`. Set it per project in `.vscode/settings.json`.

portScope.notifications.ready.description: Notify when a server that did not answer starts answering.

portScope.notifications.stopped.description: Notify when a server stops without being stopped from PortScope.
